messages.content: 你能給我從舊金山家裡到帕羅奧圖辦公室最快的路線，然後從帕羅奧圖到舊金山金門大橋的風景路線，最後從金門大橋回家最快的路線嗎？

function.name: get_directions
function.description: Retrieve directions from one location to another. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_location.description: The starting point of the journey.

end_location.description: The destination point of the journey.

message.content:
Sure! To give you accurate directions I just need a bit more detail:

1. **Your home address** in San Francisco (so I know where to start and finish).
2. **The exact address of the Palo Alto office** (or at least the street name if you’re okay with a general route).

Once I have those, I’ll fetch the fastest route from home to the office, a scenic route from the office to the Golden Gate Bridge, and finally the fastest route from the bridge back home.
